name: US law-firm websites and AI crawlers: crawler-file rules, text before JavaScript, snippet limits and Spanish pages, by state and market
description: What US law-firm websites show AI crawlers, measured from the public files and pages of the websites themselves: which of eight named AI crawlers and controls (GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, meta-webindexer) each site's crawler file (the plain-text file at its root that tells crawlers what they may visit) names and whose access to the home page it blocks, whether the apex and www host names lead to one site, how much home-page text a reader gets before JavaScript runs, and how their Spanish pages present themselves. It also counts FAQPage and Organization structured data and nosnippet and max-snippet tags on the same pages. Aggregates by state and market only; no firm or website is named or scored.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). US law-firm websites and AI crawlers: crawler-file rules, text before JavaScript, snippet limits and Spanish pages, by state and market (Version 1.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24015038
keywords: law firm website JavaScript AI crawlers
law firm websites AI crawlers data
